bias.en: Bearish · broke under $120, MACD cross failed
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $120，MACD 金叉未成

read.en: Corning fell 5.8% on Nov 4 to $118.77, trading between $115.40 and $123.80 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($124.1), 10-day ($125.3), 30-day ($142.0) and 100-day ($159.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($156.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero; the histogram narrowed toward a cross, then widened again. Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($129.85), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 康宁 11月4日下跌 5.8%，收于 $118.77，盘中区间 $115.40–123.80，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$124.1）、10 日（$125.3）、30 日（$142.0）和 100 日均线（$159.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$156.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下；柱状图此前收窄接近交叉，但再度扩大。抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$129.85），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The close broke all three written supports, including $120.0–120.5 (Mar 9 and Oct 30 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $120.0–120.5, then $123.8–125.3 (Nov 4 high, 5 and 10-day) and $129.85 (SAR, Nov 3 high). Support is $114.5–115.4 (Jul 28 low, Nov 4 low), then $110. A close above $120.5 would target $124–125; below $114.5, $110.
